{{ doc.company_name or "Company Name" }}

Offer of Employment

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.offer_date) }}

Candidate: {{ doc.candidate_name }}

Dear {{ doc.candidate_name }},

We are pleased to offer you the position of {{ doc.job_title }} with our organization. We were impressed with your qualifications and believe you will be a valuable addition to our team.

Position{{ doc.job_title }}
Base Salary{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.base_salary) }}
Variable Pay{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.variable_pay) }}
Total CTC{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.total_ctc) }}
Expected Joining Date{{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.expected_joining_date) }}
Benefits{{ doc.benefits or 'As per company policy' }}

Please review the terms and conditions outlined in this offer. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out.

To accept this offer, please sign and return this letter by {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.candidate_response_date) or 'N/A' }}.

We look forward to welcoming you to our team!



Sincerely,

Authorized Signatory

This is a computer-generated document. No signature is required.

HR Master - Recruitment Management System
